headline: Base Lines Shift on Contested Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, Nevish Line has grown busier and Marban Hollow quieter: Nevish logged 47 base events in 24 hours, up from 43, though only four came in the latest two hours; Marban fell to 32 from 39, with none in that interval. Weathered Expanse remains the heaviest churn, with 53 events against 54 previously and five in the latest two hours. Its bases now stand five Colonial, one Warden and three neutral, compared with five, two and two; Nevish’s balance has also shifted to six Warden and two Colonial from seven and one. Kuura Strand holds at 33 daily events and remains four Colonial, one Warden and one neutral, with two recent events. Linn Mercy’s 11-event day is unchanged, but it recorded none in the latest two hours. Stlican Shelf saw three events, one recent, and stands eight Colonial to one Warden. War 140 remains without a recorded victor; 34 victory towns are required.
